# tosijs-product v0.6.0

Scroll-linked animation components for tosijs.

- Docs: https://product.tosijs.net
- Source: https://github.com/tonioloewald/tosijs-product
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/tosijs-product

## Documentation

Full documentation, with live code examples, is at the links below.

## Pages

- https://product.tosijs.net/tosi-interpolator/ — <tosi-interpolator>
  Declarative CSS-property interpolation between scroll **waypoints**. Wrap any element, add
- https://product.tosijs.net/components/ — Component Reference
  Top-level container that wraps your scroll story. No required attributes.
- https://product.tosijs.net/getting-started/ — Getting Started
  A single script tag gives you everything — tosijs, tosijs-ui, and tosijs-product with all custom elements registered:
- https://product.tosijs.net/ — tosijs-product
  Build Apple-style, scroll-linked product stories with declarative web components. tosijs-product pins sections and drives Lottie, video (WebP mosaics), BabylonJS 3D, and CSS interpolation from scroll position — authored in plain HTML.
